technique_name: List differences between American and British English.
description: The main differences between American and British English include vocabulary and spelling. In American English, some words take on different spellings or pronunciations, such as 'color' (British: colour) and 'wagon' (British: waggon). American English dialects also have different word choices, such as 'elevator' (British: lift) and 'trunk' (British: boot). American English speakers generally use a less formal form of grammar, such as using 'I got' instead of 'I have gotten.' British English foll
